get.description: Authenticated article metadata and own record. include_entity absent/false preserves the original Article shape; true requires nullable entity_summary from one repeatable-read snapshot. Only exact article/source news_tech accepted effective unexcluded ready/analyzed item links proving one unique entity are eligible; same-entity observations may repeat. Unresolved, wrong-kind/source, dangling or ambiguous relationships yield null, never guessed from article identity/title/time. Summary reads direct entity first/last times, safe known counts with repeat=max(count-1,0) or both null, and closed analysis state; unknown fields stay null. No source body, dedup payload, internal identity or other user data. Unknown/duplicate query 400; invalid boolean 422; unreadable storage 503. Existing filters/pagination/auth/record unchanged.

Existing single-item owner detail/write/action remain authoritative.

get.description: Owner-only active conclusion-invalidations for one exact body version of the path content. revision and body_hash are required; omitted input_job_id means explicit null, never inferred from current body. Response repeats complete target and independent validity revision/effective flag from one repeatable-read snapshot. Fold only canonical disposition records matching full target, subtract explicit reversals of active invalidation IDs; count and stable created_at/id pagination after folding. Return actual invalidation IDs, safe reason and UTC creation time, no raw payload/history body. All active IDs contribute to validity even outside this page; reversing one need not restore validity. Unknown or duplicate query keys 400; invalid/missing required values 422; exact missing version 404; unreadable proof or unavailable provider 503. Operation receipts are not invalidation IDs. Existing actions, version summaries and definitions are unchanged.
